# The University of Tennessee at Martin

> > UT Martin is a comprehensive public university offering undergraduate and graduate programs across agriculture, humanities, business, education, and sciences with a strong emphasis on online learning and student support services.

The University of Tennessee at Martin (UTM) serves students through its Colleges of Agriculture and Applied Sciences, Humanities and Fine Arts, and other academic divisions. The university provides both traditional on-campus and online degree programs, with dedicated support services including Title IX compliance, writing assistance, and campus safety resources.

## Academic Programs Overview

- [Undergraduate Programs](https://www.utm.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/undergraduate): Complete listing of undergraduate majors and programs
- [Online Programs](https://www.utm.edu/academics/ut-martin-online-programs): UT Martin online and distance learning programs overview
- [University Catalog](https://catalog.utm.edu/content.php): Official academic catalog with courses & degree requirements

## Agriculture and Applied Sciences

- [Wildlife Science](https://www.utm.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/wildlife-science): BS in Wildlife Science with field experience & certification prep
- [MSFCS: General](https://www.utm.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/msfcs-general): Online Master of Science in Family & Consumer Sciences program

## Business and Finance

- [Finance](https://www.utm.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/finance): BSBA Finance major with real-world investment experience

## Education Programs

- [Special Education Interventionist K to Grade 8](https://www.utm.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/special-education-interventionist-k-to-grade-8): Special Education teacher licensure program for grades K-8

## Humanities and Arts

- [Visual Art Studio](https://www.utm.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/visual-art-studio): BFA in Visual Art Studio with portfolio & gallery exhibitions
- [Religious Studies](https://www.utm.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/religious-studies): Religious Studies minor in History & Philosophy dept

## Student Support Services

- [Title IX](https://www.utm.edu/offices-and-services/office-of-equity-and-diversity/titleix): Title IX compliance & sexual harassment reporting information
- [Hortense Parrish Writing Center](https://www.utm.edu/offices-and-services/hortense-parrish-writing-center): Writing tutoring & support services at Paul Meek Library
- [Environmental Health & Safety](http://www.utm.edu/alerts): Campus safety, emergency response & hazard reporting services

## Optional

- [Military Science and Leadership](https://www.utm.edu/academics/majors-and-programs/military-science-and-leadership): Army ROTC minor program in military science & leadership
